meta.name: exploratory-data-analysis
meta.description: Perform bounded, local exploratory analysis of explicitly supported scientific files. Use for redacted CSV/TSV/JSON profiles; optional NumPy, HDF5, FASTA/FASTQ, and basic image metadata inspection; missingness/leakage audits; outlier and transformation sensitivity; and rigorous EDA report scaffolds. Other domain formats are reference-only and unknown formats fail closed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对科学数据进行探索性分析并生成报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速分析科学数据集并发现异常
copy.tagline_en: Perform exploratory analysis on scientific data and generate reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly analyze scientific datasets and detect anomalies

howto.what: 装好后，用户提供科学数据文件的路径时，Claude会自动识别文件格式，检查结构与数据质量，生成Markdown格式的探索分析报告，并给出后续分析建议。
howto.when: 当用户给出科学数据文件的路径，或要求“探索”“分析”“总结”某数据文件，或询问该文件适合哪些分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析一下这个data.fastq文件
say.note: Claude会识别格式并生成带质量指标的报告。

say.text: 检查这份实验数据的CSV缺失值和异常值
say.note: Claude会做缺失值、统计摘要和离群点检查。

say.text: 对这张显微图像.nd2做个探索性数据分析
say.note: Claude会提取维度、通道等元数据并生成报告。

howto.what_en: When a user provides a path to a scientific data file, Claude automatically detects the format, inspects structure and data quality, and generates a Markdown EDA report with recommendations for downstream analysis.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user provides a scientific data file path, asks to explore/analyze/summarize a data file, or asks which analyses are suitable for a file.

say_en.text: Analyze this data.fastq file for me
say_en.note: Claude detects the format and produces a report.

say_en.text: Check this experimental CSV for missing values and outliers
say_en.note: Claude performs missingness and outlier checks.

say_en.text: Run an exploratory analysis on this microscopy image .nd2
say_en.note: Claude extracts dimensions and channels into a report.
